keestak's-short-music-showcase.html.title: keestak's short music showcase
keestak's-short-music-showcase.html.description:
Hi! I'm keestak, a musician / artist / gamedev, and this page is meant to be a short showcase of my musical ability. I'm currently looking for opportunities to make music for cool games!My most well-known music is for a game called WINDOWKILL by torcado (rated overwhelmingly positive on steam with over 3k reviews). You can see a trailer here that includes some of the music I've made for the game alongside gameplay:I've also made music for the game 'Heck Deck' by torcado and the game 'Stick and Stack' by cammymoop. I'm also working on music for a few games currently in-development and plenty of music for game jam games. You can check my soundcloud for a wider selection of my music or DM me personally to hear more things I've made!I have a wide range of genres I can cover so there's a good chance that if you want a specific type of music, I can make it! I particularly enjoy making music focused on melodies/motifs and atmosphere. Here's a small selection of songs that showcase my skill level:WINDOWBREAKER: euphoric, emotional, battle-type beat WINDOWSHATTER: fast-paced, intense, and a bit of breakcore influence WINDOWFRAME: chill, main-menu music inspired by the 3ds-era (The three songs above are from the WINDOWKILL soundtrack and share the same musical identity. The following songs are a selection from other projects.)SPACE EXPLORING: relaxed, laid-back exploration music with a bit of mystery EVERLASTING NIGHT: dramatic, cinematic, emotional, orchestral jazz GREEN TEA: whimsical, rhythm-focused, soundcloud-core type stuff GHOST BIRD: atmospheric backing music for a beautiful and mysterious environment Thanks for checking my music out and considering me for your project! Please reach out if you're interested in having me on!discord: keestak
email: keestak@proton.meABOUT MONETIZATION: For smaller projects (individual songs, <15 mins of music, etc) I generally ask for a fair per-minute rate based on whatever budget you have. For larger projects (eg, 30 minutes of music or more, OSTs for larger games) I strongly prefer a revenue share option where I generally ask for ~%10 of net revenue (after platform royalties). But I'm flexible if you really need a different option!

info_showOrphanNodes.description: Show nodes that are not connected to any other nodes.

info_showAttachments.description: Show attachments like images and PDFs as nodes in the graph.

info_allowGlobalGraph.description: Allow the user to view the global graph of all nodes.

info_allowExpand.description: Allow the user to pop-out the graph view to take up the whole screen

info_attractionForce.description: How much should linked nodes attract each other? This will make the graph appear more clustered.

info_linkLength.description: How long should the links between nodes be? The shorter the links the more connected nodes will cluster together.

info_repulsionForce.description: How much should nodes repel each other? This will make disconnected parts more spread out.

info_centralForce.description: How much should nodes be attracted to the center? This will make the graph appear more dense and circular.

info_edgePruning.description: Edges with a length above this threshold will not be rendered, however they will still contribute to the simulation. This can help large tangled graphs look more organised. Hovering over a node will still display these links.

info_minNodeRadius.description: How small should the smallest nodes be? The smaller a node is the less it will attract other nodes.

info_maxNodeRadius.description: How large should the largest nodes be? Nodes are sized by how many links they have. The larger a node is the more it will attract other nodes. This can be used to create a good grouping around the most important nodes.
